meta.title: Use the authoritative stable Kubernetes API VIP for the guarded deployment-controller upgrade
meta.author: manager

feature.problem_statement: The protected deployment-controller upgrade expects the control-node endpoint https://10.99.0.21:6443, while typed inventory, kube-vip, DNS, TLS, and the protected kubeconfig publisher establish https://10.99.0.10:6443 as the stable API frontend. The mismatch makes the upgrade fail safely before mutation and blocks restoration of controller health.
goals: Make every active guarded upgrade identity source agree on the typed stable API VIP https://10.99.0.10:6443.
Preserve exact, fail-closed context and server validation with sanitized pre-mutation diagnostics.
Prevent the backend control-node endpoint, DNS names, environment values, or kubeconfig defaults from becoming fallback upgrade authority.
Classify and preserve legitimate 10.99.0.21 references that represent the control node, post-DNAT NetworkPolicy egress, or immutable history.
non_goals: Provide high availability or change the current kube_vip_single_host topology.
Change typed kubeconfig publication, Terraform endpoint authority, Kubernetes Service endpoints, or controller NetworkPolicy CIDRs.
Dispatch the live upgrade, change GitHub environment protection, or provision the trusted runner boundary.
Bulk-replace historical locks, recovery evidence, or unrelated node-address contracts.
scope_in: The active deployment-controller artifact lock, upgrade script, bootstrap checker, active producer or activation consumers coupled to that lock, and focused tests.
A static contract tying active upgrade expectations to .codicarium_inventory_input.cluster.frontends.kubernetes_api vip and port without runtime Terraform execution.
Repository validation and exact-head CI for the PR-only correction.
scope_out: Live workflow dispatch, Helm or Kubernetes mutation, Argo changes, and authorization activation.
Environment protection remediation tracked by infra #1259 and trusted-runner remediation tracked by infra #1289.
Historical or separately versioned one-shot recovery artifacts unless an active-lock coupling is proven.

requirements.statement: Active guarded deployment-controller upgrade identity sources MUST expect exactly https://10.99.0.10:6443, derived from the typed Kubernetes API frontend VIP and port.
requirements.rationale: The stable kube-vip frontend is the declared platform endpoint and the endpoint published in protected kubeconfigs.

requirements.statement: The upgrade MUST preserve exact context and server equality, explicit kubectl and Helm endpoint pinning, pre-mutation failure, sanitized evidence, and no fallback endpoint.
requirements.rationale: The correction must not weaken the cluster-identity security boundary.

requirements.statement: The implementation MUST classify all active 10.99.0.21 references and change only upgrade-identity consumers; node, post-DNAT egress, and immutable historical uses MUST remain intact.
requirements.rationale: 10.99.0.21 remains the real control-node and Service backend endpoint.

requirements.statement: Negative regression coverage MUST reject the node endpoint, DNS-only values, URL suffixes, wrong ports, and inventory-lock-script drift before any live or mutating command.
requirements.rationale: A focused fail-closed contract prevents recurrence and accidental broadening.

requirements.statement: The PR MUST pass focused upgrade/bootstrap tests, topology and diff checks, workflow validation, and exact-head protected CI before merge.
requirements.rationale: The endpoint is part of a protected live-upgrade path and requires auditable delivery evidence.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Given current typed inventory, when active upgrade identity contracts are evaluated, then the lock, guard, checker, and coupled active consumers resolve exactly to https://10.99.0.10:6443 while legitimate node and post-DNAT references remain 10.99.0.21.

Given a wrong context or server, when upgrade preflight runs, then it aborts before readiness or mutation, records mutation=false, and emits only match or mismatch outcomes without actual identity values.

Given attempts to substitute https://10.99.0.21:6443, the API DNS name, a URL suffix, wrong port, environment override, or kubeconfig default, when static and unit guards run, then each substitution is rejected and generated commands remain pinned to https://10.99.0.10:6443.
Given the exact PR head, when repository and protected CI validation runs, then all required checks pass without dispatching a live workflow or mutating the cluster.

test_plan.approach: Add focused contract tests that parse typed inventory and assert active lock, script, checker, and coupled active consumers equal https://10.99.0.10:6443; maintain an explicit classification for retained 10.99.0.21 uses.
Exercise wrong-context, wrong-server, dual-mismatch, node-endpoint, DNS, suffix, port, and override cases; assert sanitized evidence, mutation=false, and zero mutating commands.
Run focused upgrade/bootstrap suites, workflow syntax or actionlint, topology validation, and repository diff checks; inspect generated kubectl and Helm arguments for exact VIP pinning.
Verify exact-head GitHub checks and perform read-only explicit-context VIP reachability, TLS SAN, release, and resource-version preflight without workflow dispatch or mutation.

review_checks: Confirm typed inventory is the only endpoint authority and active consumers agree.
validation_checks: Static contract and exact-head CI pass for https://10.99.0.10:6443.

review_checks: Confirm no fallback, override, default-context, or unsanitized diagnostic path was introduced.
validation_checks: Mismatch tests prove pre-mutation failure and mutation=false evidence.

review_checks: Review the classified 10.99.0.21 reference inventory and preserve node, NetworkPolicy, and immutable history uses.
validation_checks: Focused scan finds no stale active upgrade identity source and no unrelated replacement.

review_checks: Inspect negative cases for .21, DNS, suffix, wrong port, and independent drift.
validation_checks: All negative tests fail closed before live or mutating commands.

review_checks: Require independent review of the exact PR head and unchanged live-upgrade gates.
validation_checks: Protected exact-head CI succeeds; no workflow dispatch or cluster mutation occurred.

perspectives.summary: GO for a narrow PR-only correction; avoid claiming HA, preserve node and historical references, and audit all active lock consumers.
GO provided all active upgrade/bootstrap identity copies use the typed VIP and negative drift tests prove no fallback or independent divergence.
NO-GO for live dispatch; code may proceed to obtain implementation, exact-head CI, sanitized pre-mutation proof, and read-only readiness evidence.

council.consensus_summary: Proceed to a PR-only code stage. Keep live upgrade blocked by environment protection issue #1259 and dedicated trusted runner issue #1289, and never replace legitimate 10.99.0.21 node or post-DNAT egress uses.
